_doc: Hull rasp (M5-A3P-1806, Ch17): the hullgnaw's two slots. carapace: the spawn body, its salt scabs dry and rough (the vertex wetness drops under the crust), its bore-holes and main seam glowing spawn_wound a little faster than the Ch1 boss's; rib: the salt-white keel timbers, rougher and drier than the hullgnaw's oak. write_materials.py on game/shaders/creature/creature.gdshader.
